text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Landing~! Teio-chan, I'm home~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Welcome back~ ...Wait, what's with all that stuff?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I borrowed a bunch of things from everyone at the dorm~☆ Look, look! Check out this magazine!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Umm... 'All Capable Adults Are Doing It! Heart-Pounding☆ At-Home Date Special'?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: The dates in here are so chic, mature, and sparkling! So I thought I'd try them out~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ooh~ sounds fun! I'll do it with you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay~! Alrighty then, first up is—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Setting the mood with aromatherapy! Dropping some oil into the diffuser, and...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wah, mist is coming out~! So this is the scent of an adult...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: *sniff sniff* ......... Isn't this scent a bit too strong?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm, really? But now that you mention it, it kinda stings the back of my nose... *sniff sniff*

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ~~~~!!?? My nose buuuurns!! Did I use too much oil?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It says jigsaw puzzles are great for at-home dates because two people can solve them together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Does this piece go in the top right corner? That one over there connects with this...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Got it! That piece goes here, so this goes like this, this, and—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yaaay~! We finished it~~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Wait, it's already over?! Our at-home date ended in three minutes?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: This is so boring! Boo, boooo!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Watching movies is a classic at-home date staple! Let's watch the movie recommended in the magazine!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Aren't they way too close to the heroine?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wahh?! Their foreheads bumped together! That's way too bold...!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No, no, no, that's way too fast! Wh-Whoa?! Wait, wait, wait...!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking through the academy, I spotted Mayano Top Gun looking rather gloomy.
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I'm feeling a little blue.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You see, I tried all kinds of dates from the magazine's mature plans. I wanted to feel all thrilled and excited, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I couldn't feel excited at all. And now, I don't even know what a date is supposed to be anymore...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems that in her effort to act mature and imitate the magazine articles, she lost sight of what makes a date meaningful.
choice_data_list: A date is just doing things you find fun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Things that are fun...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told her that magazines are just examples, and suggested she try different things to discover what kind of date suits her best.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I see. You're right! Just because it's in a book doesn't mean it's the right fit for Maya!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Having fun is what really matters on a date! Maya's gonna try a bunch of other stuff!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun regained her energetic spirit. It looks like her worries have cleared up!
